text: In consideration of the Works the Owner shall pay the Contractor the lump-sum Contract Price of EUR 531,000,000 (five hundred and thirty-one million euros), comprising an offshore portion of EUR 327,000,000 and an onshore portion of EUR 204,000,000, exclusive of Value Added Tax, payable in accordance with Clause 15 and Appendix C. The Contract Price is fixed and not subject to escalation or exchange-rate adjustment, except as adjusted under Clause 14.
title: Contract Price
